scope: Frozen Super hook-trust JSON-RPC behavior against isolated synthetic Codex app-server peers.
runtime_claim: Synthetic Codex child implements app-server --stdio and records each actual request/reply. All launches use isolated storage, a synthetic provider key, and an ephemeral loopback endpoint; the endpoint receives no traffic. The synthetic peer computes a stable test currentHash from its fixture config and models config/batchWrite in memory. Captures do not verify production Codex hook execution.
